# veogen

AI media generation hub (video/music/image/chat/movie scripts) on Google's
Gemini family. FastAPI backend (port 11150) + React/Vite frontend (11151) +
FastMCP streamable HTTP surface at /mcp.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): stack, quick start, what works / what needs a key
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md): install guide (partly stale - README quick start wins)
- [docs/README](docs/README.md): design docs (older content)
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): full corpus for LLM ingestion

## Key files
- `backend/app/main.py` - FastAPI app, /health, /api/v1/diagnostics, /mcp mount
- `backend/app/api/router.py` - v1 route aggregator (19 endpoint modules)
- `backend/app/mcp_server.py` - FastMCP tools
- `backend/app/services/gemini_service.py` - Gemini provider facade (chat real, media honest stubs)
- `frontend/src/App.js` - routes (29 pages)
- `frontend/e2e/smoke.spec.ts` - Playwright smoke suite
